name: Eight-Cycle
definition: The cycle graph on eight vertices, canonically embedded in $Q_4$ by flipping coordinates $1,2,3,4,1,2,3,4$ in cyclic order.
properties: It is an even cycle and a two-dimensional partial cube with isometric dimension four and ordering width one. It is not ample, median, a hypercube, a path, or a star. Every one-coordinate conditioning is a rank-one maximum four-vertex path, so it is conditioning-minimal non-ample; projecting a coordinate gives the non-ample six-cycle, so it is not pc-minimal non-ample.
